newest.title: House Data Center Energy Bill: Who Pays for Your Rising Utility Costs?
newest.description: House Data Center Energy Bill: Who Pays for Your Rising Utility Costs?. Whether the rapid scaling of AI infrastructure and development is being adequately checked by public policy and internal transparency. What we covered: • House passes bill aimed at making data centers cover more of their energy costs • Anthropic says Claude is helping build the next version of itself • OpenAI will regularly disclose unexpected or unauthorized AI behavior after six new incidents • Huawei unveils new chip technologies as it intensifies the AI challenge to Nvidia • AP says global AI safety efforts depend on U.S.-China cooperation amid rising tensions One lead story. The other headlines are supporting evidence, complications, or counterexamples. Listener question: Should AI companies be legally required to pay for all grid upgrades their data centers trigger? What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules. Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next. What changed.
